description: WHY Google rejected or limited something: every DISAPPROVED or APPROVED_LIMITED ad, asset (headlines, images, sitelinks, Performance Max assets) and keyword on the account or one campaign, with Google’s policy topic, its effect, the evidence (offending text, a broken landing page and its HTTP code, restricted countries) and appeal state. includeApproved lists everything. Read-only, 0 credits.
